landingMinProducts.title: Products in stock to index
landingMinProducts.description: A landing page set to Automatic is indexed by search engines while at least this many of its products are in stock (and, while Automatic landing pages is on, at least In-stock variants to index of their variants).

landingUrl.title: Landing page address
landingUrl.description: Where a landing page is on your website: {categoryUrl} (its category's page), {category}, {brand}, {facet} (the listing parameter of its facet: grade or attr.<slug>) and {value} (the facet's value), for example {categoryUrl}?brand={brand}&{facet}={value} or /shop/{category}/{brand}/{value}. Query pairs with an empty name or value are left out.

auto.title: Automatic landing pages
auto.description: Off: only the landing pages you create. Category brand: every category and brand with enough products and variants in stock is a landing page without creating it (indexed and in the sitemap; one you create wins). Category brand facet: also every category and brand with each value of the field Automatic facet.

autoFacet.title: Automatic facet
autoFacet.description: With Category brand facet: the field whose values make automatic pages: the slug of a field shoppers filter by (for example color), or grade for condition grades. Empty, or a field shoppers do not filter by: no facet pages.

autoMaxPages.title: Most automatic pages in the sitemaps
autoMaxPages.description: At most this many automatic landing pages are listed in the sitemaps, those with the most products in stock first, so each read stays light on a small database.

autoMinProducts.title: Products in stock for an automatic page
autoMinProducts.description: An automatic landing page exists while at least this many of its products are in stock. A landing page you create for such a category and brand (and facet value), set to Automatic, is indexed from the lower of this and Products in stock to index.

autoMinInStockVariants.title: In-stock variants to index
autoMinInStockVariants.description: An automatic landing page is indexed only while at least this many variants of its products are in stock; while Automatic landing pages is on, so is a landing page you create set to Automatic.

autoCopy.title: Copy of automatic pages
autoCopy.description: Formula: the automatic page title and description patterns below, from the category, brand and facet names and what is in stock. AI: when staff save a product, Ecommerce writes one of its automatic pages with your AI provider (AI copy on and its key in Connections) and keeps it as a landing page you can edit; until then, and when the provider does not answer, the formula.

autoTitle.title: Automatic page title
autoTitle.description: An automatic landing page's heading and part of the page title: {category} and {brand} (their names), {facet} (the facet field's name) and {value} (its value), {products} and {variants} (in stock), {price} (the lowest price in stock) and {storeName}, for example {brand} {category}.

autoDescription.title: Automatic page description
autoDescription.description: An automatic landing page's description, with the same placeholders, for example Shop {brand} {category} at {storeName}: {products} products in stock from {price}. Empty: the category's or brand's description, as other listings.

attributeUrl.title: Attribute page address
attributeUrl.description: Where the page of one attribute (a color, a size …) lives on your website, for example /glossary/{slug}. Empty: no attribute pages.

attributeTitle.title: Attribute glossary title
attributeTitle.description: An attribute glossary page's part of the page title when it has no SEO title: {name} is the attribute, {unit} its unit, {values} its first values, {category} the page's category, {storeName} the name in titles, for example What is {name}?

attributeDescription.title: Attribute glossary description
attributeDescription.description: Used when an attribute has no SEO description or text of its own, with the same placeholders, for example {name} ({unit}) for {category}: {values}. Empty: the default description.

gradeUrl.title: Condition grade page address
gradeUrl.description: Where the page of one condition grade lives on your website, for example /grades/{key}. Empty: no grade pages.

gradeTitle.title: Grade glossary title
gradeTitle.description: A grade glossary page's part of the page title when it has no SEO title: {name} is the grade, {category} the page's category, {storeName} the name in titles, for example {name} condition explained.

gradeDescription.title: Grade glossary description
gradeDescription.description: Used when a grade has no SEO description, text or description of its own, with the same placeholders, for example What {name} means for {category} at {storeName}. Empty: the default description.
